scope: Actual installed Full1080 native renders reviewed for authorized green/blue/glass footage, source/matte/composites. Green clothing and hair retained; blue airplane detail and semi-transparent propeller blur retained; glass/pouring edges and partial alpha retained. Display composites are inspection thumbnails, separate from qualified linear-Merge numeric tests.
observations: Green backing/tracking marks removed while green costume remains. Fine hair edges visible.
Blue backing removed; soft propeller/motion-blur edges have partial alpha.
Glass and stream remain visible with partial alpha; residual backing/refraction color can need manual despill.
limitations: No promise of physically perfect refraction or a perfect matte on arbitrary footage.
